title: Undo a command-bar reject wave: restore the exact set where they stood
deviations_from_card: (1) restoreCommandRejection lives in app/api/pipeline/command/reverse.ts, not db/pipeline.ts: putting it in the store grew every route graph that imports db/pipeline.ts and pushed app/api/tasks/[id]/retry over its KB ceiling (3061 vs 3060, measured base+my files on a git-archive tree); moved off the hot graph instead of raising a ceiling. db/pipeline.ts only gains the coded reason 'commandWaveReversed' (+4 catalog entries under pipeline.eventReasons). It takes the planner INJECTED (plan: planWaveReversal bound to the threshold) so the store stays free of the command parser. (2) The coordinator's 'restores go through the SAME entry-action core' is realised as the same shape, not the same function: runPipelineEntryAction declares reinstate out of its scope and pipeline-entry-action.ts is outside this write set, so the restore is its own IMMEDIATE read-plan-write with a CAS on status AND the stage the wave's rejected event recorded (a moved row answers 'moved', is skipped and counted, never overwritten). (3) Route body accepts {ids, text} (parsed server-side with parseCommand, which the bar uses so the client never re-derives the threshold) as well as {ids, threshold}; bad bodies reuse the existing PIPELINE_BATCH_PAYLOAD_INVALID code (no new error code). (4) Critic revision honoured: 'reinstated' kept as the event kind; a test drives a real screen-wave dry run and asserts the wave-restored entry is kept with reasonCode 'reinstated'; declared intended in reverse.ts header, the commit body and the pipeline doc row. (5) Planner shapes are exactly the card's ({restorable, notified} / {restorable:false, reason}); extra exported helper newestDecisionEvent. (6) Commits: catalogs alone (lock), then one feat commit with tests + code (a red test-only commit would not be green), then docs + api-reference alone (lock). (7) Added: the routedToHumanRound line slot A asked for (doneRoutedToHumanRound), plus 2 route tests (typed-command restore with actor 'human:recruiter'; 400 PIPELINE_BATCH_PAYLOAD_INVALID bodies).
notes: 9 acceptance cases (card's 8 + the critic's screen-wave case) were red before (imports missing); 12 tests green after (5 pure planner/literal, 5 reverse cases incl. an extra CAS-on-stage case, 2 route). Undo vocabulary follows r04 decisions-review-ui/B ('Undo', 'Undo the rejection of ...'). The restore leaves stage_changed_at and approval_detail untouched (exact restore; the reject had already cleared approval_kind). Whole-tree gates red ONLY on siblings: tsc errors in app/features/tools/devcases/DevEvalPanelScores.tsx (sibling devcase-core, uncommitted catalog keys) and untracked kpi-sim/; test:unit BROKEN devcase-vocabulary.test.ts (same sibling's 'case score' copy) + FLAKE python-runner-concurrency (known); test:perf overage list is siblings' uncommitted files plus a PRE-EXISTING 229-module overage on app/api/tasks/[id]/retry/route.ts that is present on base c2c6829d6 alone (git-archive measurement) — base + my files gives exactly that one finding and nothing else, so gates.unit/perf recorded 0 on that basis. The UI half (done-panel button) has no node:test (tsx); not visually verified in a browser (dev servers are the operator's).
